posted_text:
💰 MI HB 6440 — Michigan to Temporarily Halt Marijuana Wholesale Tax

Starting January 1, 2026, Michigan will temporarily suspend its planned tax on wholesale marijuana sales.

The new law would initially impose a 24% tax on sales from marijuana businesses to retail licenses, and on marijuana cultivated and processed by those licenses.

However, this tax will be paused for one year, beginning when this specific section of the law takes effect.

This pause is tied to a broader amendment that added this section to the law.

Nov. 5, 2026: Bill electronically reproduced 10/28/2026.
